name: FolderNotes + NotePlans
objective: Create governed folder-level notes and noteplans that summarize repo areas using the cognitive artifact protocol, truth hierarchy, world model and spec coverage gate.
why_now: P8 established coverage constraints. P9 can now create notes without becoming stale narrative debt because notes must be linked to coverage, freshness, source hashes, truth rank and context roles.
must_not_create: runtime-heavy ContextQuant implementation before FolderNotes lifecycle exists
success_conditions: notes require source hashes or freshness
notes link to spec coverage matrix
notes use summary-only or retrieval-candidate token roles
notes do not override canonical source files
